credit: Baroque Soprano, Alto, Tenor and Bass Recorder recordings by Versilian Studios, from the Versilian Community Sample Library (VCSL).
processSummary: Distinct native SATB sustain recordings. Scientific MIDI roots spectrally verified (VCSL filename octaves are one below scientific notation). Leading silence trimmed, 25 Hz subsonic high-pass, resampled 48k to44.1k with polyphase filter, constant per-sample normalization to0.085 RMS subject to0.7 peak cap, 3ms de-click at start. Native tongued attacks and breath retained.40ms smoothstep crossfade to phase-matched pre-loop waveform creates seamless sustained loops; no added vibrato/tremolo.16-bit stereo WAV. Measured median pitch offsets corrected through tuningSemitones.
